reviewFlags.issue: The catalog model is HC5632-15 with a hyphen. The pages name the model as HC5632/15 with a slash, and no page prints the hyphenated form. The research relied on this close code, so the catalog number needs a check.
The two Israeli retailer pages conflict on warranty length. Electroeshed says two years and Lior Electric says one year, both attributing it to Electra. No warranty fact is published.
The catalog origin text is self-contradictory: it names the Netherlands as the origin and then says the product is mostly made in China or Indonesia. No fetched page confirms either.
The catalog gives comb lengths of 3-15 mm and 16-28 mm. The fetched retailer pages list two hair combs without lengths, so the comb sizes are unconfirmed.
Catalog uses HC5632-15; sources print HC5632/15. Same code, but confirm the catalog form.
The two Israeli retailer pages conflict on warranty length (two years vs one year, both via Electra). No warranty published.
Catalog origin text is self-contradictory (Netherlands vs made in China/Indonesia) and unverified.
Catalog cutter width 41 mm, 1 mm steps, Li-Ion, 100-240V, no-oil and comb lengths 3-15/16-28 mm were not confirmed by any fetched page.
